According to the review, marine strain MBBTBC9 survives:

- **Temperature:** 4–50 °C
- **Salt (NaCl):** 0.5–7%
- **pH:** 7–13
- **Heavy metals:** up to 500 ppm

This is stated in Section 3.1 (Environmental adaptability) on page 3 of the paper, citing reference [61]. The review does not give a separate heavy-metal ranges breakdown beyond the 500 ppm upper limit.
